success_criteria.positive: Exit zero with requested tests actually executed; a compile-only or empty filter run is not a pass.
success_criteria.negative: Compile and run the exact named tests; each listed test must end as a named behavioral failure at the described assertion. Compiler errors, timeouts, missing tests, setup panics or dependency failures do not count.
success_criteria.restoration: After every negative, all production and test/fixture bytes equal the pre-fix positive snapshot and Cargo.lock is unchanged. The subsequent unfiltered three-package green run must execute and pass the restored tests.
success_criteria.limits: No result here self-issues source_qualified_exact_head, real production provider/sink, durable receipt recovery, future-calendar efficacy, physical-effect authority or release.
success_criteria.post_fix_identity: Scoped fix is last per AGENTS. If it changes source, preserve and report the diff/new hashes; do not claim the earlier green run tested those new bytes and do not rerun tests merely after fix/format.
